cohort: Simulated cohort of pregnant individuals at 32 weeks gestation, invasively ventilated due to COVID-19-related acute respiratory distress syndrome
finding: For pregnant individuals with COVID-19-related acute respiratory distress syndrome, elective delivery is comparable but not superior to expectant management for gestational ages from 28 to 34 weeks, while for neonates, elective delivery was superior if gestational age was ≥30 weeks and if the rate of intrauterine death or maternal mortality risk were high.
